title: Quenched Peppery Mediterranean Rice Pilaf
description: A fluffy, peppery rice pilaf infused with dashi and rice syrup, perfect for a soothing sick day Mediterranean meal.
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water until water runs clear, then drain.
Heat the lazy susan spinner on medium, add olive oil and let it swirl.
Add minced garlic and diced onion to the oil, sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the cracked peppercorns, salt, oregano, and lemon zest, cooking for another minute to release aromas.
Place the rinsed rice into the vessel, swirling to coat each grain with the seasoned oil.
Pour in the dashi extract and rice syrup, then cover and bring to a rolling boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18 minutes, or until rice is tender and liquid absorbed.
Remove from heat, fluff the rice with a fork, sprinkle chopped parsley, and serve warm.
